meta.name: autotask
meta.description: Every Autotask entity at the command line, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers ticket-aging, workload, unbilled-time, and account-360 questions no other Autotask tool can. Trigger phrases: `list autotask tickets`, `autotask company 360`, `who is overloaded in autotask`, `unbilled time in autotask`, `autotask ticket aging`, `use autotask`, `run autotask-cli`.
